support.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. No WebGPU / WebGL renderer (one Canvas 2D path), no keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

props.name: disableScroll
props.description: Keeps the page from scrolling while a finger moves on the chart (needed to pan a zoomed chart or drag points)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name (tap toggles a series)

props.name: interaction
props.description: Pinch zoom, pan (drag when zoomed) and double-tap reset; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the plot area, in pixels

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` tokens, then the theme colors)

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, compact units `k` / `万`, separators, month and weekday names of time axes). Mini-programs have no `<html lang>`: pass the app language

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

events.name: onPointClick
events.description: Called when a point (or bar) is tapped

events.name: onPlotClick
events.description: Called when the plot area is tapped where there is no point

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the touched (or hovered) points change

events.name: onZoom
events.description: Called when the user zooms or pans

translationResources.title: Heatmap
translationResources.description: A grid of cells colored by value, over categories or numbers on both axes: activity by weekday and hour, correlation matrices, maps of a measure. Hover a cell to lift it, highlight its row and column and mark its value on the color legend.

basic.title: Weekly activity
basic.description: 7 × 24 cells over category axes. The default ramp is perceptual (OKLab) and follows the theme: from a near-white tint to a deep primary color in light mode, from a tint of the surface to a bright one in dark mode; the color legend shows its range. yCategories lists the rows from bottom to top, hence the reversed weekdays.

color-scale.title: Diverging scale
color-scale.description: colorScale lists the colors from the lowest to the highest value and accepts CSS variables, so the middle stop follows the theme. A symmetric valueRange keeps 0 in the middle of the scale.

large-grid.title: 20,000 cells
large-grid.description: A 200 × 100 grid with numbers on both axes. interaction={{ zoom: "xy" }} enables zooming (off by default for heatmaps): Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, drag to pan, double-click to reset.

activity.title: Contribution calendar
activity.description: A year of daily contributions like a GitHub profile: weeks as numeric columns, weekdays as rows, an x format that turns the week number into its month, and palette={["var(--success-color)"]} for a green ramp that reads well in light and dark themes.

correlation.title: Correlation matrix
correlation.description: Pairwise correlations of product metrics with colorScale="diverging": the danger color below colorMidpoint (0), the primary color above, a neutral middle that follows the theme; the same translated names are used for both axes.

retention.title: Cohort retention
retention.description: Share of each monthly signup cohort still active after N months: null values leave the future cells empty, which draws the classic triangle.

conversion.title: Click a cell
conversion.description: Conversion rate by traffic source and device. onPointClick gives item.index, the index of the clicked cell in data, which leads back to its sessions and orders for the readout; onPlotClick clears it.

rack-temperatures.title: Live sensor grid
rack-temperatures.description: Inlet temperatures of the sensors of a server aisle, refreshed by a setInterval cleared on pause and unmount. A fixed valueRange keeps the same color for the same temperature at every refresh, and colorScale goes through theme colors from cool to hot.

confusion-matrix.title: Confusion matrix
confusion-matrix.description: Predictions of an image classifier, each cell colored by its share of the actual class. renderTooltip finds the hovered cell from item.index to show its count, and the recall and precision on the diagonal.

sales-regions.title: Switching metrics
sales-regions.description: Revenue, growth and margin by region and quarter: each metric brings its own colorScale (sequential, diverging around zero or a custom list), valueRange and format, switched with a RadioGroup.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Sessions by weekday and 3-hour slot, with the weekday and hour names of the app language; tap a cell to read its value.

HeatmapConfig.xCategories: Column names in order (collected from the data when omitted)
HeatmapConfig.yCategories: Row names from bottom to top (collected from the data when omitted)
HeatmapConfig.colorScale: Colors from the lowest to the highest value (interpolated in OKLab), or a built-in theme-aware ramp: sequential (default) or diverging
HeatmapConfig.valueRange: Values at the ends of the color scale; the data range by default
HeatmapConfig.name: Name of the value in the tooltip
HeatmapConfig.radius: Corner radius of the cells, in pixels
HeatmapConfig.format: Formats the values in the tooltip
HeatmapConfig.colorMidpoint: Value at the middle of the color scale (diverging data); 0 for diverging ramps spanning it, else the middle of the range

HeatmapCell.x: Column: a category name or a number
HeatmapCell.y: Row: a category name or a number
HeatmapCell.value: Value mapped to the color scale; null leaves the cell empty

weekly-activity.title: Weekly activity
weekly-activity.description: Commits per day and time slot; the categories set the order of the columns and rows.

color-scale.title: Diverging color scale
color-scale.description: A correlation matrix on a fixed -1 to 1 range: blue for negative values, red for positive ones, rounded cells.

props.valueName: Name of the value in the tooltip
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
